why: English text, generated from `Intl.DisplayNames` and then reviewed. `names` is the country name a player reads: four entries correct a CLDR name the game cannot use as-is, and the rest pin a name that is already right so that a CLDR release moving it is reported as a shadowed change rather than shipped. `capitals` renders a fetched or pinned capital into English — mostly typography, plus the two glosses `capitals.json` no longer carries itself. `languages` and `currencies` override the fetched CLDR display name for a tag or an ISO 4217 code. Generated by `node scripts/data/review-en.ts`, which also writes the side-by-side review artifact; hand-edited afterwards, and the generator reports what it would have written differently.
